title: aeo-audit-lite: repeated-sampling share-of-model measurement with confidence intervals
description:
Runs a buyer prompt against an AI engine several times and measures how often a brand appears versus named competitors — its share of model — with a confidence interval.

A single screenshot proves nothing: AI answers are non-deterministic. This measures by repeated sampling, the same way every time.

Python standard library only. Mock mode by default with clearly illustrative numbers; set PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY for real measurement.
